title: SDK Levels, Variants, APKs, and App Bundles Quick Check

questions.prompt: Match each SDK setting to its contract.
questions.explanation: The three values govern different compatibility boundaries.

questions.prompt: An Android App Bundle is normally installed directly on a device with adb install.
questions.explanation: An AAB is publishing input used to generate device-specific APKs.

questions.prompt: Spot the bug: minSdk is 26, a method introduced in API 31 is called unconditionally, and compileSdk is 36.
questions.answer: The running API 26–30 devices do not implement the method even though compilation succeeds
questions.explanation: A runtime guard, compatibility API, alternative implementation, or higher minSdk is required.
